headline: Vermont plays on alone after Bryant falls at SMU
dek: Vermont held Clemson scoreless to earn a trip to Kansas City, leaving it as the only conference program with a match left on the schedule. Bryant's season ended with a loss at SMU. Vermont heads west with eleven wins, six draws, and two losses, having conceded sixteen goals all season.
